steps.content: 08:46 Dark alleys in the neighborhood outside the square

steps.speaker: Captive
steps.content: Ugh. Let me go... Let me go! I don't know anything. I'm here on their orders!

steps.speaker: Captive
steps.content: Grunt... he said the Legion would be gone forever today, and the old order would return to Syndicate!

steps.speaker: Captive
steps.content: Haha... <color=#fb9259>Everyone</color>! Everyone in Syndicate wants them dead!

steps.speaker: Captive
steps.content: For almost two decades, Syndicate has been held together by the rules, trade, transactions, and turf conflicts. That's the order of Syndicate! But the Legion has disrupted our order, that's why we all... Mmph!
Hella thrusts one end of the water pipe into his mouth.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: "We all"? Speak for yourself. Now answer me. Who ordered you here?! Who took the lead, your gangs or the Public Security Bureau?

steps.speaker: Captive
steps.content: Mmph! Stop it... I don't know anything, I just...

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Ambush!
Tat-tat-tat... From across the road, a dozen of guns fire at you. You avoid them all thanks to Hecate's warning, but the captive is covered with bullet holes.
A familiar sheriff appears before you with a team.

options: Looks like someone can't wait to explain what's just happened

steps.speaker: Sheriff
steps.content: You should've followed our orders, sir.
steps.female_content: You should've followed our orders, madam.

steps.speaker: Sheriff
steps.content: Mr. Burns fully understands your position. He doesn't need a Sinner-lover to remain here.

options: That's just nasty. Someone's at the end of their rope?

steps.speaker: Sheriff
steps.content: ...Mr. Burns has said, this is the punishment for your failure to do your duty.

steps.speaker: Sheriff
steps.content: You failed to apprehend the targets you were asked to, and you failed to put the dangerous Sinners under control. Your failure to play your role has put the Public Security Bureau in a tight spot.

Do you mean the role I played when you used the whole Suspect R thing to trick me? Thanks to you, I got myself involved in the Syndicate gang fights; thanks to you, I tried to hunt down a Legion Sinner who had nothing to do with the riot.
What did that kid have on you?

steps.speaker: Sheriff
steps.content: ...Enough said! Now shut up... shut up for good.
From behind him, a team of sheriffs rush out and point their guns at you. They're getting their own hands dirty, a sign that they are desperate and have lost basic judgement...
The two Sinners plant themselves in front of you, facing the guns with no fear.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: ...No one gets to harm the Chief.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Or should I say none of you useless scums gets to harm the Chief? Come on... I'll send you to meet your maker.
Screech!

A monstrous armored vehicle rolls into the center of the battlefield and blocks all the bullets coming your way. You hear the huge iron gate being kicked open, and a dozen or so of people jump down from the vehicle and start charging, howling as they go.
The door on the driver's side, which is closer to you, opens, and out comes a metal prosthetic leg, followed by that familiar grim voice.

steps.speaker: Earl
steps.content: Don't get yourself involved, Chief, or you'll get yourself in trouble in some internal blame game.

steps.speaker: Earl
steps.content: You should learn to let the gangsters do the dirty work.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Instead of wasting your time here, why don't you go around and seek out your <color=#fb9259>old friends in Syndicate</color> for a drink?

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: They must have a lot to say to you.

steps.speaker: Earl
steps.content: Next up, the Legion's gonna follow their unreliable boss and rise in rebellion. What are you gonna do, Chief?

steps.speaker: Earl
steps.content: Eliminate us for the authorities, or join us in turning this place upside down?
...You know this old fox wouldn't strike for no good reason.
Surely you won't go back to the sheriffs, but it's way too dangerous to just jump ship. You look at Earl, and an idea hits you.
I'll go with you. But you need to do something for me first.
